data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to control Sunmi Android barcode scanner via its native service.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to bind to the Sunmi scanner service, listen to barcode scan events and connection status, and trigger scans programmatically. It wraps the Sunmi Android SDK for hardware barcode scanners.
use_when: You need to use the built‑in barcode scanner on Sunmi Android devices
You require low‑level control over scanner service lifecycle
You prefer event‑driven (stream) handling of scan results
avoid_when: Your app must run on iOS or non‑Sunmi Android devices
You want a cross‑platform camera‑based scanner
You prefer a plug‑and‑play solution without manual service binding
strengths: Direct access to Sunmi hardware features
Stream API for real‑time scan and status events
Allows manual control of service binding/unbinding
weaknesses: Limited to devices that support Sunmi SDK
data.setup_notes: Add the package, then call SunmiScanner.bindService() (optionally hide toasts) in initState and SunmiScanner.unbindService() in dispose. No extra Dart code generation needed, but the plugin works only on Android devices with Sunmi SDK.
